question: What should GCC fragrance and candle brands ask before sourcing custom paper tube packaging?
buyer_context: Fragrance, candle, cosmetics and premium retail buyers comparing paper tube packaging
answer_blocks: GCC fragrance and candle buyers should confirm product diameter, height, fill weight, closure preference, display channel, finish direction and whether the tube needs to hold glass, metal or lightweight retail items.
Paper tube packaging can be practical for cosmetics, candles, fragrance, tea, gifts and specialty retail products when the product weight and closure structure are reviewed early.
MUGE PACKAGING supports custom paper tube packaging by diameter, height, cap structure, material, printing and finishing options.
rfq_checklist: Retail display and shelf handling needs
Surface finish direction and artwork status
Fit test and sample review questions
